dedupe_keys.name: data for harmonized gap filled dataset from 20 urban flux tower sites for the urban plumber project

description: The Urban-PLUMBER collaboration, led by UNSW Sydney, publishes observations and model inputs from 20 urban flux-tower sites across several continents. Site periods differ, with observations spanning parts of 2002–2020. The full collection includes raw and quality-controlled observations, gap-filled series, model spin-up inputs and site characteristics such as surface-cover fractions. A smaller archive repeats quality-controlled observations in NetCDF. Zenodo distributes NetCDF, text and CSV material in ZIP packages, free under CC-BY-4.0, with citation of relevant site sources requested. Gap filling and meteorological reconstruction introduce uncertainty, while tower footprints represent particular urban neighbourhoods. These limitations matter when transferring results to an entire city. The data can calibrate urban energy-balance simulations and compare heat or cooling-demand responses across sites. It complements land-cover maps with measured fluxes and documented local conditions. The associated processing code is deposited separately and requires additional input data.
